blocks.content: Cyber Security refers to the protection of computer systems, networks, and digital data from unauthorized access, cyber attacks, and damage. As the use of the Internet and digital technologies increases, cyber security has become an essential aspect of modern computing.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Cyber security encompasses essential concepts for protecting digital systems, networks, and data.
Computer viruses and malware are distinct forms of malicious threats with specific characteristics.
Firewalls and antivirus software serve as key defense mechanisms against security breaches.
Understanding phishing, hacking, and cyber safety practices is vital for digital protection.

blocks.content: Cyber security involves technologies, processes, and practices designed to protect computers, networks, and data from cyber threats such as viruses, malware, hacking, and phishing attacks.

items: Protects sensitive information from unauthorized access.
Prevents data theft and financial fraud.
Ensures privacy and confidentiality.
Maintains the integrity of computer systems.
Protects against cyber attacks.

blocks.content: A computer virus is a malicious program that attaches itself to a legitimate program and spreads from one computer to another, causing damage to files and system operations.

items: Self-replicating program.
Spreads through infected files and software.
Can damage files and operating systems.
May slow down system performance.

cells: Infects the boot sector of storage devices.
Infects documents created in applications such as MS Word.

blocks.content: Malware is malicious software designed to harm, disrupt, or gain unauthorized access to computer systems.

cells: Malicious program that spreads by attaching to files.

blocks.content: A firewall is a network security system that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic based on predefined security rules.
It acts as a barrier between a trusted internal network and untrusted external networks such as the Internet.
Antivirus software is a program designed to detect, prevent, and remove computer viruses and other types of malware.

items: Scans files and programs for malicious code.
Detects and removes viruses and malware.
Provides real-time protection.
Prevents unauthorized access.

blocks.content: Phishing is a cyber attack in which attackers attempt to trick users into providing sensitive information such as passwords, credit card numbers, or personal data.

items: Distinguish between various types of computer viruses and malware categories.
Understand the primary operational functions of firewalls vs antivirus software.
Recognize key differences between phishing techniques and hacking methods.
Memorize core cyber safety practices frequently tested in competitive examinations.

blocks.content: Hacking refers to unauthorized access to computer systems or networks in order to steal data, manipulate systems, or cause damage.

items: Use strong and unique passwords.
Avoid clicking on suspicious links.
Install and update antivirus software.
Keep operating systems and applications updated.
Do not share personal information online.
Virus is a malicious program that spreads by attaching to files.
Malware includes viruses, worms, trojans, and spyware.
Firewall monitors network traffic.
Antivirus protects systems from viruses and malware.
Phishing is used to steal sensitive information.
